description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Controller::Permission' class, a Catalyst controller handling project permission management, including listing, adding, editing, making owner, and revoking permissions within a web application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Permission
classes.description: Controller class for managing project permissions, including listing, adding, editing, transferring ownership, and revoking permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list project permissions, including organization and user permissions, and renders the permissions template.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add new organization or user permissions to the project.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load a specific permission (user or organization) based on the provided ID.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles POST requests to edit a permission's role.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Handles POST requests to transfer project ownership to a user permission.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Handles POST requests to revoke (delete) a permission.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the permissions index page.
